forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {持|も}ちかけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to propose, to suggest, to make overtures
definitions.explanation: To bring up a proposal or suggestion to someone, often implying an attempt to persuade or negotiate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかけて⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: He came to me with a new business proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかけられた。
examples.english: Our business partner proposed a joint development project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧⟦{投資話|とうしばなし}→投資話：30445_toushibanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかける⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
examples.english: Be careful of scams that approach you with suspicious investment proposals.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). The proposal takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and the person approached takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold) + ⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to apply/bring to). The combination conveys bringing something (usually a proposal) to someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかける (bring up a topic/proposal)
・⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかける (approach with a consultation)
・⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかける (propose a deal)
・⟦{縁談|えんだん}→縁談：13847_endan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ちかける (propose a marriage arrangement)

USAGE: Often used in the passive, {持|も}ちかけられる, when describing receiving a proposal, and with てくる ({持|も}ちかけてくる) when the approach comes toward the speaker. It can carry a slightly negative nuance when the proposal is unsolicited or suspicious.
